findings.title: Release-014 review run artifact and payload are not pre-covered by cleanup
findings.reason: Also raised by maintainability-reviewer. This lane keeps its CE run artifact untracked under gitignored .context/ (as release-013-65a2c12 was referenced but never tracked) and commits no review payload; review.json and land.json are already covered. Land re-verifies tracked .baton/quick and .context coverage at the final head.

findings.title: CHANGELOG 0.1.4 date may precede the eventual tag date
findings.reason: Also noted by learnings-researcher. The tag date depends on future separate human merge and tag approvals and cannot be known at review; no guard requires equality and v0.1.2 shipped with a one-day offset. Surfaced to the owner for the tag decision.

findings.title: Work exit evidence says 12 changed files while the candidate has 20
findings.reason: The CLI-generated work receipt counts the 12 CLI subjects, which the .baton-only cleanup bookkeeping did not change; D11 and the body record the later cleanup, and this review write regenerates exit evidence.
